title: The Holy Rosary
summary: The great Marian devotion: meditating the mysteries of Christ's life through the beads.
intro: The Rosary weaves vocal prayer and meditation together. Choose a set of mysteries — traditionally the Joyful on Mondays and Saturdays, the Sorrowful on Tuesdays and Fridays, the Glorious on Wednesdays and Sundays, and the Luminous on Thursdays — and let each decade carry you into a scene from the Gospel.

mysterySets.name: The Joyful Mysteries
mysterySets.summary: The Incarnation and hidden years — from the Annunciation to finding the Lord in the Temple.

mysteries.title: The Annunciation
mysteries.reflection: The angel Gabriel announces to Mary that she is to be the Mother of God, and she answers, *Let it be done to me according to your word.*

mysteries.title: The Visitation
mysteries.reflection: Mary visits Elizabeth, and the child leaps in Elizabeth's womb. *Blessed are you among women.*

mysteries.title: The Nativity
mysteries.reflection: Christ is born in Bethlehem and laid in a manger — God made small for our sake.

mysteries.title: The Presentation
mysteries.reflection: The Child is presented in the Temple, and Simeon foretells the sword that will pierce Mary's soul.

mysteries.title: The Finding in the Temple
mysteries.reflection: After three days the twelve-year-old Jesus is found teaching in the Temple. *Did you not know I must be about my Father's business?*

mysterySets.name: The Sorrowful Mysteries
mysterySets.summary: The Passion of Christ — from the Agony in the Garden to the Crucifixion.

mysteries.title: The Agony in the Garden
mysteries.reflection: In Gethsemane Jesus sweats blood and prays, *Not my will, but yours be done.*

mysteries.title: The Scourging at the Pillar
mysteries.reflection: Christ is bound and scourged, bearing in his body the punishment for our sins.

mysteries.title: The Crowning with Thorns
mysteries.reflection: The soldiers mock the King of kings with a crown of thorns.

mysteries.title: The Carrying of the Cross
mysteries.reflection: Jesus takes up the Cross and carries it to Calvary for love of us.

mysteries.title: The Crucifixion
mysteries.reflection: On the Cross Christ gives up his life, and gives us his Mother: *Behold your son... behold your mother.*

mysterySets.name: The Glorious Mysteries
mysterySets.summary: Christ's victory and Our Lady's glory — from the Resurrection to the Coronation.

mysteries.title: The Resurrection
mysteries.reflection: Christ rises victorious from the tomb, conquering sin and death.

mysteries.title: The Ascension
mysteries.reflection: The risen Lord ascends to the right hand of the Father.

mysteries.title: The Descent of the Holy Spirit
mysteries.reflection: At Pentecost the Spirit descends upon Our Lady and the Apostles, and the Church is sent out.

mysteries.title: The Assumption
mysteries.reflection: Mary is taken up body and soul into heavenly glory.

mysteries.title: The Coronation of Mary
mysteries.reflection: Our Lady is crowned Queen of Heaven and earth.

mysterySets.name: The Luminous Mysteries
mysterySets.summary: The public ministry — from the Baptism in the Jordan to the Institution of the Eucharist.

mysteries.title: The Baptism in the Jordan
mysteries.reflection: The Father's voice proclaims, *This is my beloved Son,* as the Spirit descends.

mysteries.title: The Wedding at Cana
mysteries.reflection: At Mary's word — *Do whatever he tells you* — Christ works his first sign.

mysteries.title: The Proclamation of the Kingdom
mysteries.reflection: Jesus calls all to conversion and the forgiveness of sins.

mysteries.title: The Transfiguration
mysteries.reflection: On the mountain Christ's glory shines out before Peter, James, and John.

mysteries.title: The Institution of the Eucharist
mysteries.reflection: At the Last Supper Christ gives his Body and Blood under the signs of bread and wine.
